rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: TANydal
rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, 1993).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 1993 as 'Summer Lady'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink. Strong fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Notes: Treloar Roses says the buds of Summer Lady pale pink and ivory and very long and slim...
